player_prompt.intro:
Wo reko 2048 wɔ {board_size}x{board_size} board so. Wo botae ne sɛ wo beduru {target_tile} tile bere a wo de nkrataa koro koro bɛka bom!
Nkrataa a wɔde di dwuma: [Up], [Down], [Left], [Right]. Nkrataa no hyɛɛ ase bere a wɔbɛhyia, na wɔn dwuma nso pii.

invalid_move.invalid_action: Nkrataa a wɔde di dwuma no yɛ saa. Fa '[Up]'/'[Down]'/'[Left]'/'[Right]' no.
invalid_move.no_change: Akwankyerɛ Kuw no ansesa - wɔpaw ɔkwan foforo.

outcome.win: Ayɛ wo! Woduu {target_tile}! Score a ɛdi mu {score}.
outcome.lose: Nkrataa nni hɔ bio. Nkrataa kɛse {max_tile} - nkontabuo a etwa to {score}.
